payload.goal: Every instruction, chat, prompt, skill, and response is machine-parseable across the Cloudflare fleet (server-side) and DeepChat/ChatBox (client-side).

definition.name: schema_bound
definition.what: Artifact is emitted against a declared, versioned JSON Schema; schema_version field is always present.

definition.name: deterministic_validation
definition.what: validate(S, artifact) -> {ok, errors[]} runs with no network and no randomness; exit 0/1.

definition.name: typed_semantics
definition.what: Every semantic element (step, claim, gate, finding, status, decision, reference) is a typed field; natural language appears only in string fields carrying a declared role.

definition.name: version_reject
definition.what: Unknown schema_version is rejected, never silently guessed.

principle.name: dual_representation
principle.rule: Every artifact has a canonical machine-parseable form plus a deterministic human rendering. The parseable form is authoritative; the rendering is derived.

mode_A.label: structured_native
mode_A.form: pure JSON (already mostly true: D1 rows, ops_ai_log, task_dod_register)

mode_B.label: prose_with_manifest
mode_B.form: machine-readable manifest (gates/steps/claims as typed tree) + prose body as a role-tagged string field; markdown is rendered from the manifest

taxonomy.canonical: kaizen digest, daily brief, weekly watchtower

taxonomy.target: mode_B: claims/citations manifest (extends COMPUTATIONAL-VERIFICATION-1); body stays prose

envelope.name: universal_envelope
envelope.rationale: One outer shape means any consumer can route/validate before reading the kind-specific payload.

architecture.role: single source of truth; one JSON Schema file per kind, versioned

architecture.location: @qnfo/validate (TS, consumed by all Workers) + validate.py (Python mirror for local guards)
architecture.role: one implementation per language, both read the same schema files

points: API ingress (chat/prompt/response routes validate before persist)
architecture.posture: advisory(warn) on ingress, blocking(reject) on canonical-store write

points: DeepChat guard suite (prompt-store-verify.py, scheduler-guard.py, model_guard.py) extended to validate manifests
ops-exec loop: prose-then-extract post-processor wraps responses in response envelope
architecture.posture: blocking on prompt stores; advisory on responses

architecture.role: thin client; enforcement is server-side at QNFO-OPS gateway, client only renders the contract

phases.name: foundation
phases.deliverable: schema registry (envelope + 5 schemas: message, plan, finding, gate-manifest, event) + shared validator (TS + Python mirror) + one pilot path end-to-end
phases.why: nothing else can proceed without the registry and validator

phases.name: structured_native_lift
phases.deliverable: plans, findings, ops_ai_log, deployment_history, paper_revision_log validate against schemas
phases.why: already JSON-adjacent; lowest lift, highest coverage

phases.name: gate_manifest
phases.deliverable: encode the MANDATORY gate chain (this prompt's gates) as a machine-readable manifest; prompt-store-verify.py validates it

phases.name: runbooks
phases.why: operational docs are the least parseable today

phases.name: response_envelope
phases.why: closes the loop on agent -> storage

first_action.what: Create QNFO/qnfo-schemas (envelope + 5 schemas), write @qnfo/validate + validate.py, wire ops_ai_log writes to validate on persist (server) and prompt-store-verify.py to validate the gate manifest (client).
first_action.proof: live probe: emit -> validate -> persist -> read-back -> re-validate, all exit 0
